name: Isola del Giglio (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a white sailing ship within a white laurel wreath.
history: Municipal flag of Isola del Giglio, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: sailing ship within a laurel wreath
